@kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown_years = 5

kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law = {
	default = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law
	flag = imperial_policy

	kCAFG_culture_intolerant_law = {
		modifier = {
			different_culture_opinion = -20
		    minority_different_culture_opinion = -30
			glory_hound_same_culture_opinion = 30
		}
		
		can_keep = {
			trigger_if = { # To remove trigger tooltip
				limit = {
					NAND = {
    					NOT = { has_game_rule = kCAFG_tolerance_laws_off }
						T_kCAFG_can_have_culture_tolerance_law = yes
						OR = {
							is_independent_ruler = yes
							OR = {
								T_kCAFG_vassal_is_allowed_to_change_culture_tolerance_laws = yes
								any_liege_or_above = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_intolerant_law }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				always = no
			}
		}
		can_have = { T_kCAFG_can_have_culture_tolerance_law = yes }
		can_pass = {
            has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law
			T_kCAFG_can_decrease_culture_tolerance_law_trigger = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = "kCAFG_allowed_to_change_tolerance_laws_tt"
				OR = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					T_kCAFG_vassal_is_allowed_to_change_culture_tolerance_laws = yes
				}
			}
		}
		should_start_with = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_independent_ruler = no }
				top_liege = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_intolerant_law }
			}
			trigger_else = {
                T_kCAFG_should_start_with_intolerant_culture_law = yes
			}
		}
		flag = F_kCAFG_intolerant_to_other_cultures

		pass_cost = { prestige = V_kCAFG_change_culture_tolerance_law_prestige_cost }
		revoke_cost = { prestige = V_kCAFG_change_culture_tolerance_law_prestige_cost }

        on_pass = {
			set_variable = {
				name = kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown
				years = @kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown_years
			}

			# the flag is applied after the on_pass effects, but we need to update now
			add_character_flag = kCAFG_TMP_applying_culture_intolerance_law
			every_realm_county = {
                every_county_province = {
                    E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
                }
            }
			remove_character_flag = kCAFG_TMP_applying_culture_intolerance_law
        }

        ai_will_do = {
			if = {
				limit = {
                    has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law
                    ai_compassion < V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_negative_threshold
                    ai_boldness > V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_threshold
                }
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

    kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law = {
		modifier = {}
		can_keep = {
			trigger_if = { # To remove trigger tooltip
				limit = {
					NAND = {
    					NOT = { has_game_rule = kCAFG_tolerance_laws_off }
						T_kCAFG_can_have_culture_tolerance_law = yes
						OR = {
							is_independent_ruler = yes
							OR = {
								T_kCAFG_vassal_is_allowed_to_change_culture_tolerance_laws = yes
								any_liege_or_above = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				always = no
			}
		}
		can_have = { T_kCAFG_can_have_culture_tolerance_law = yes }
		can_pass = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_intolerant_law }
				T_kCAFG_can_increase_culture_tolerance_law_trigger = yes
			}
			trigger_else_if = {
				limit = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_tolerant_law }
				T_kCAFG_can_decrease_culture_tolerance_law_trigger = yes
			}
			trigger_else = {
				T_kCAFG_can_change_culture_tolerance_law_trigger = yes
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = "kCAFG_allowed_to_change_tolerance_laws_tt"
				OR = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					T_kCAFG_vassal_is_allowed_to_change_culture_tolerance_laws = yes
				}
			}
		}
		should_start_with = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_independent_ruler = no }
				top_liege = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law }
			}
			trigger_else = {
				NOR = {
					T_kCAFG_should_start_with_intolerant_culture_law = yes
					T_kCAFG_should_start_with_tolerant_culture_law = yes
				}
			}
		}

		pass_cost = { prestige = V_kCAFG_change_culture_tolerance_law_prestige_cost }
		revoke_cost = { prestige = V_kCAFG_change_culture_tolerance_law_prestige_cost }

        on_pass = {
			set_variable = {
				name = kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown
				years = @kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown_years
			}

			# the flag is applied after the on_pass effects, but we need to update now
			add_character_flag = kCAFG_TMP_applying_culture_indifference_law
			every_realm_county = {
                every_county_province = {
                    E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
                }
            }
			remove_character_flag = kCAFG_TMP_applying_culture_indifference_law
        }

		ai_will_do = {
			if = {
				limit = {
                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_intolerant_law
                            ai_compassion > V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_threshold
                    		ai_boldness < V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_negative_threshold
                        }
                        AND = {
                            has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_tolerant_law
                            ai_compassion < V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_negative_threshold
                    		ai_boldness > V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_threshold
                        }
                    }
                }
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

    kCAFG_culture_tolerant_law = {
		modifier = {
			different_culture_opinion = 8
		    minority_different_culture_opinion = 15
			glory_hound_same_culture_opinion = -30
		}
		can_keep = {
			trigger_if = { # To remove trigger tooltip
				limit = {
					NAND = {
    					NOT = { has_game_rule = kCAFG_tolerance_laws_off }
						T_kCAFG_can_have_culture_tolerance_law = yes
						OR = {
							is_independent_ruler = yes
							OR = {
								T_kCAFG_vassal_is_allowed_to_change_culture_tolerance_laws = yes
								any_liege_or_above = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_tolerant_law }
							}
						}
					}
				}
				always = no
			}
		}
		can_have = { T_kCAFG_can_have_culture_tolerance_law = yes }
		can_pass = {
            has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law
			T_kCAFG_can_increase_culture_tolerance_law_trigger = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = "kCAFG_allowed_to_change_tolerance_laws_tt"
				OR = {
					is_independent_ruler = yes
					T_kCAFG_vassal_is_allowed_to_change_culture_tolerance_laws = yes
				}
			}
		}
		should_start_with = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { is_independent_ruler = no }
				top_liege = { has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_tolerant_law }
			}
			trigger_else = {
				T_kCAFG_should_start_with_tolerant_culture_law = yes
			}
		}
		flag = F_kCAFG_tolerant_to_other_cultures

		pass_cost = { prestige = V_kCAFG_change_culture_tolerance_law_prestige_cost }
		revoke_cost = { prestige = V_kCAFG_change_culture_tolerance_law_prestige_cost }

        on_pass = {
			set_variable = {
				name = kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown
				years = @kCAFG_culture_tolerance_law_cooldown_years
			}
			
			# the flag is applied after the on_pass effects, but we need to update now
			add_character_flag = kCAFG_TMP_applying_culture_tolerance_law
			every_realm_county = {
                every_county_province = {
                    E_kCAFG_update_province_target_culture_tension = yes
                }
            }
			remove_character_flag = kCAFG_TMP_applying_culture_tolerance_law
        }
		
        ai_will_do = {
			if = {
				limit = {
                    has_realm_law = kCAFG_culture_indifferent_law
                    ai_compassion > V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_threshold
                    ai_boldness < V_kCAFG_ai_law_change_negative_threshold
                }
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}
}
